name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_speech
title: Eleven v4: Text to Speech
summary: Generate expressive speech from text with Eleven v4, the quality-focused ElevenLabs model. Direct the performance with audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] written into the script, or upload a voice sample to clone a voice and narrate the script in it. One audio file is output. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, and character voiceovers.
